item.title: The boardwalk and railings are not nearly substantial enough - broken AGAIN, 17th October
item.description:
The ridiculous wire railings are entirely insufficient, lacking in durability, clearly as idiots have broken them again, and the boardwalk itself, which took MONTHS to repair earlier in the year, is already failing. This is a beautiful park and the boardwalk idea wonderful but if needs a more permanent solution making it more sustainable. The materials used look cheap and flimsy like garden decking. Perhaps cameras are also needed or another deterrent so as it's not ruined for those capable of not destroying it.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Tudway Road, Kidbrooke
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Overgrown Hedge and Barbed Wire, 17th October
item.description:

I understand people want to secure their gardens but they need to maintain their hedges and signage should surely be erected if barbed wire is safe and necessary...
